Currently: Weeping Bridge · Normal
Location
Location sets the base chat pool (with a few emotes mixed in). Pick a Mood below to layer faster, emote-heavy chat on top — 20% still comes from the location, 80% from the mood.
Normal mood means only the location chat runs, at its usual pace. Any other mood adds a second, much faster stream of mostly-emote reactions on top — the busier chat gets, the more obvious it is something's happening. The last two locations are special: donations/messages there are still yours to trigger manually, and the mood grid is disabled while in them.
Special Situations
Eat the Lemon / Get in the Morgue push hard and are text-heavy. 1M Subs (Crypt) is full send: 100% mood pool (location chat pauses entirely), fastest pace, and fires the 1,000,000 subscribers banner the moment you click it.
